events.headline: Checked Shelby County public notices and its October 6, 2026 notice; that notice contains no CTC/xAI update. The published 15-unit, 247.5 MW cohort remains a historical reported configuration; current installed count and delivered power were not established by this check.

Reviewed final MDEQ permit 0680-00119, issued March 11, 2026, and the current registry. The permit lists 41 turbines in three groups (17, 16 and 8). The separate 27-unit, 495 MW cohort comes from a historical court filing; it is not a current full-site operating total.

Reviewed TCEQ records: original registration 177263 application received August 15, 2024; amendment issued January 22, 2025; Federal Operating Permit O4721 issued January 16, 2026. The 360.5 MW equipment cohort is a permit-based figure, not verified current output. Exact first-power day remains unverified.

District court Doc 135 allows the United States to intervene but rejects unilateral dismissal of NAACP v. xAI/MZX Tech. The order addresses intervention and dismissal, not whether the defendants violated the Clean Air Act or how many turbines are operating.
Socrates South: OPSB September 17, 2026 table lists 200 MW gas generation operational from August 3, 2026. Capacity excludes battery storage; current output is unknown.
MDEQ notices Air-Construction PSD for Entergy's Traceview Advanced Power Station — 754 MW CCGT in Ridgeland, third dedicated gas plant for AWS's Madison County data centers (notice ends 07/14)
Ohio clears its fifth behind-the-meter gas plant in New Albany — EdgeConneX PowerConneX joins the Williams fleet.
Williams STY approved with 36 conditions: 296 MW of turbines + 116 MW battery for Meta's campus.

STY: OPSB September 17, 2026 table records June 25 approval, 250 MW gas generation and under-construction status. The June 26 announcement date and older uncited 296 MW turbine figure describe different reporting bases; a physical 46 MW reduction is not established.
Williams files Neo — 666 MW of simple-cycle turbines + 260 MW BESS. The largest Socrates tranche yet.
FERC orders six grid operators to fast-track large-load interconnection and report spare capacity within 30 days.
NAACP moves for a preliminary injunction to shut down xAI's Memphis turbines under the Clean Air Act.
Court record: 57 turbines on site at Southaven vs 41 permitted (consultants' 2026-05-15 inventory, NAACP v. xAI Doc 52)
Satellite (Vantor LG01, 0.3 m): equipment yard imaged; visible units exceed 15-unit permit footprint; active vapor plume.
Satellite (Vantor WV02, 0.3 m): ~35-40 major modules on site; four graded expansion pads consistent with 41-unit permit envelope.

Crusoe reported that the first Abilene phase was running on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and that its first two buildings had been energized within a year. This establishes operation by the report date, not an exact first day of BTM generation.

TCEQ original technical review records August 15, 2024 as the project received date for registration 177263. This corrects the legacy August 1 date; January 11, 2025 relates to the later modification application.
